title: Ratify product constitution
acceptance_criterion: Constitution fixes source-to-action chain, global scope, publication limits and operator authority; approval recorded.

title: Create global jurisdiction registry
acceptance_criterion: All countries and territories are represented; parent/relationship model supports all declared jurisdiction layers; missing-universe test passes.

title: Define regulatory source taxonomy
acceptance_criterion: All binding, rulemaking, administrative, licence, market and secondary source classes map to controlled concepts.

title: Define cannabis product and substance ontology
acceptance_criterion: Product form, intended use, cannabinoid, controlled status, dosage, material and packaging concepts pass multi-regime review.

title: Define activity, licence and facility ontology
acceptance_criterion: Cultivation through destruction plus import/export, research, prescribing and dispensing map without jurisdiction-specific information loss.

title: Approve provenance and truth-class specification
acceptance_criterion: Fact, normalized fact, interpretation, estimate, forecast and recommendation have required evidence and review rules.

title: Approve source-rights policy
acceptance_criterion: Collection, storage, transformation, redistribution and termination controls are documented and enforceable.

title: Approve data classification and retention model
acceptance_criterion: Classification, residency, retention, legal hold and deletion policies are mapped to storage and access controls.

title: Complete system threat model
acceptance_criterion: Threat model covers cross-tenant access, public leakage, source injection, SSRF, evidence tampering, model misuse and privileged access.

title: Approve service and bounded-context map
acceptance_criterion: Ownership and transactional boundaries are fixed; canonical and derived stores are explicitly separated.

title: Establish architecture decision process
acceptance_criterion: ADR template, owners, decision authority, supersession and review cadence are operational.

title: Build phase-zero proof matrix
acceptance_criterion: Representative regulatory archetypes prove ontology, provenance, authorization and source-rights design; GO/HOLD signed.

title: Provision canonical PostgreSQL platform
acceptance_criterion: HA database, migrations, backups, restricted owner roles and environment isolation verified.

title: Implement source registry service
acceptance_criterion: Source CRUD enforces rights, allowed hosts, cadence, freshness SLA, parser and owner requirements.

title: Implement secure acquisition runtime
acceptance_criterion: Idempotent fetch, rate limiting, backoff, run locks, SSRF blocking, credentials and dead-letter handling pass tests.

title: Implement immutable evidence storage
acceptance_criterion: Every successful fetch writes versioned, hash-verified, retention-controlled raw evidence before processing.

title: Implement document normalization pipeline
acceptance_criterion: HTML, XML, JSON, PDF, scans, tables and attachments produce versioned normalized artifacts with processing lineage.

title: Implement passage and citation anchoring
acceptance_criterion: Stable page/section/paragraph/table anchors survive reprocessing and reconstruct exact source passages.

title: Implement document version and diff engine
acceptance_criterion: Structural and semantic differences identify additions, deletions, moves, status and effective-date changes.

title: Implement regulatory instrument and provision service
acceptance_criterion: Documents map to versioned instruments, provisions, legal effects, commencement and supersession relationships.

title: Implement hybrid regulatory search
acceptance_criterion: Exact legal terms and semantic concepts retrieve evidence-filtered results; indexes are reproducibly rebuilt.

title: Build analyst triage and review workbench
acceptance_criterion: Analysts compare versions, inspect citations, classify materiality, route specialist review and record decisions.

title: Implement publication, correction and retraction
acceptance_criterion: No publication without evidence/review; corrections propagate to alerts, exports and public projections.

title: Certify evidence-spine release
acceptance_criterion: Acquisition, integrity, lineage, change recall/precision, RLS, leakage, replay and correction evidence meet Phase 1 gate.

title: Implement organization operating profiles
acceptance_criterion: Versioned customer facts cover entities, facilities, licences, products, activities, jurisdictions and business roles.

title: Implement applicability DSL parser and validator
acceptance_criterion: DSL validates typed facts, operators, missing-input policy, conflict policy and deterministic AST compilation.

title: Implement deterministic applicability evaluator
acceptance_criterion: Evaluations are reproducible by profile, rule, date and input hash and emit complete reason traces.

title: Implement obligation extraction candidates
acceptance_criterion: Provision candidates extract subject, action, object, conditions, exceptions, triggers, timing and evidence requirements with citations.

title: Build obligation specialist-review workflow
acceptance_criterion: Risk-tier routing, jurisdiction authority, dual review and version approval are enforced.

title: Implement obligation versioning and supersession
acceptance_criterion: Current and historical obligations are time-bounded; superseded obligations cannot generate current actions.

title: Implement control and SOP mapping
acceptance_criterion: Obligations map to control objectives, procedures, evidence, owner and frequency with partial/conflict semantics.

title: Implement compliance calendar and deadlines
acceptance_criterion: Relative and fixed deadlines recalculate at runtime and preserve source/effective-date lineage.

title: Implement alert rules, routing and digests
acceptance_criterion: Alerts deduplicate, apply materiality and entitlements, explain applicability and track acknowledgement.

title: Implement assessments, findings and remediation
acceptance_criterion: Assessments create evidence-backed findings, owners, due dates, approvals and closure history.

title: Implement customer evidence room and attestations
acceptance_criterion: Tenant-isolated evidence, signatures, retention, download controls and audit bundles work end to end.

title: Certify obligation and applicability release
acceptance_criterion: Counsel-reviewed benchmark has no critical false negatives; reason traces, supersession, deadlines and tenant isolation pass.

title: Implement canonical entity registry
acceptance_criterion: Entities retain official identifiers, historical names, jurisdiction, status, evidence and public/private ownership.

title: Implement person and beneficial-owner model
acceptance_criterion: People and ownership records follow privacy, evidence, validity and restricted-access controls.

title: Implement reversible entity resolution
acceptance_criterion: Merge proposals expose evidence/confidence; automatic high-confidence merges meet 99% precision; split restores history.

title: Implement facility registry
acceptance_criterion: Facilities link addresses, geolocation, operators, authorized activities, capacities and validity history.

title: Implement licence-class normalization
acceptance_criterion: Jurisdiction licence classes map to canonical activities without losing local conditions.

title: Implement licence ingestion and history
acceptance_criterion: Pending, active, conditional, suspended, expired, revoked and denied states retain official evidence and change history.

title: Implement certification and GxP records
acceptance_criterion: GACP/GMP/GDP/GLP/accreditation scope, issuer, validity, findings and non-compliance are normalized.

title: Implement inspection, enforcement and recall intelligence
acceptance_criterion: Events link entities/facilities/products, severity, resolution and source evidence.

title: Implement counterparty risk components
acceptance_criterion: Scores are decomposable, versioned, evidence-backed and never substitute for underlying facts.

title: Build counterparty monitoring and alerts
acceptance_criterion: Licence, ownership, quality, enforcement and recall changes re-evaluate approved counterparties.

title: Build due-diligence report and review workflow
acceptance_criterion: Reports expose sources, freshness, unresolved conflicts, reviewer status and export restrictions.

title: Certify entity/licence/counterparty release
acceptance_criterion: Resolution benchmark, licence history, privacy, quality evidence, risk explainability and monitoring meet gate.

title: Implement product and substance classifier
acceptance_criterion: Products retain composition, form, strength, intended use, packaging and jurisdiction-specific controlled status.

title: Implement corridor version model
acceptance_criterion: Origin, transit, destination, parties, product, purpose, quantity, date and route are immutable per version.

title: Define mandatory corridor gate library
acceptance_criterion: Legal, licence, permit, quota, quality, customs, logistics, insurance, contract and counterparty gates are versioned.

title: Implement corridor gate evaluator
acceptance_criterion: Gate results are deterministic, evidence-backed, expiry-aware and explain missing inputs.

title: Implement import/export permit intelligence
acceptance_criterion: Authority, permit class, prerequisites, forms, fees, lead times and validity are normalized with official evidence.

title: Implement customs, tax and tariff layer
acceptance_criterion: Commodity classifications, duties, taxes, declarations and uncertainty are date- and corridor-specific.

title: Implement quality and batch-release gates
acceptance_criterion: GACP/GMP/GDP, testing, CoA, release and facility conditions evaluate against product and corridor.

title: Implement logistics, security and transit gates
acceptance_criterion: Carrier, storage, security, transit, route and receipt requirements are modeled and reviewed.

title: Implement GO/CONDITIONAL GO/HOLD determination
acceptance_criterion: Determination exposes blocking gates, conditions, assumptions, confidence, validity and specialist approval.

title: Build market-entry project workspace
acceptance_criterion: Projects sequence gates, owners, dates, documents, counterparties and approvals.

title: Build controlled deal room and document readiness
acceptance_criterion: Matter-scoped external access, conditions, documents, expiration and audit logging work.

title: Certify corridor release
acceptance_criterion: Representative corridors pass counsel review, transit/product/quantity changes trigger re-evaluation, and no GO lacks evidence.

title: Implement canonical metric registry
acceptance_criterion: Every metric has definition, inclusions, exclusions, units, period, methodology, owner and revision policy.

title: Implement market data zones and contracts
acceptance_criterion: Raw, standardized, reconciled, canonical, analytical, published, private and restricted zones enforce contracts and rights.

title: Onboard official market datasets
acceptance_criterion: Approved official sales, production, inventory, licence, patient, tax and trade datasets retain source lineage.

title: Integrate licensed commercial datasets
acceptance_criterion: POS, price or commercial feeds enforce field-level rights, tenant entitlements and termination controls.

title: Implement unit, currency and period normalization
acceptance_criterion: Conversions retain rate/date lineage and never merge incompatible market definitions.

title: Implement metric reconciliation engine
acceptance_criterion: Components, totals, revisions and source conflicts produce explicit exceptions instead of silent overwrites.

title: Implement observation revision history
acceptance_criterion: Actual, preliminary, estimate, imputed, forecast and scenario states remain distinct and time-versioned.

title: Implement forecast and scenario registry
acceptance_criterion: Models expose baselines, assumptions, confidence intervals, versions, approval and backtesting.

title: Implement commercial signal detection
acceptance_criterion: Tenders, shortages, openings, capital projects, recalls, funding and partnerships produce evidence-backed signals.

title: Build market explorer and executive reports
acceptance_criterion: Charts and reports expose as-of dates, definitions, states, sources, confidence and reconciliation notes.

title: Implement opportunity score methodology
acceptance_criterion: Score components and weights are transparent, versioned, challengeable and never hide gating failures.

title: Certify market-intelligence release
acceptance_criterion: No conflicting canonical totals; actual/estimate/forecast labels, rights, reconciliation and forecast baselines pass.

title: Implement qualified partner discovery
acceptance_criterion: Search returns only entitlement-appropriate counterparties with licence, quality, corridor and freshness context.

title: Implement structured demand and supply requests
acceptance_criterion: Requests specify product, quantity, quality, jurisdictions, dates, documents and confidentiality.

title: Implement matching and eligibility rules
acceptance_criterion: Matches cannot bypass licence, product, corridor, quality or counterparty gates.

title: Implement transaction workspace
acceptance_criterion: Parties manage questions, conditions, documents, approvals and change history in a matter-scoped room.

title: Implement transaction readiness determination
acceptance_criterion: Readiness combines current corridor, counterparty, documents, quality and commercial conditions.

title: Implement shipment milestone model
acceptance_criterion: Permit, dispatch, customs, release, transit, receipt and exception events retain evidence and responsible party.

title: Implement quality-event and dispute workflow
acceptance_criterion: Deviations, rejected batches, recalls, disputes and corrective actions are isolated and auditable.

title: Implement counterparty performance history
acceptance_criterion: Delivery, document, quality and payment outcomes are evidence-backed and permissioned.

title: Implement transaction notifications and escalations
acceptance_criterion: Material condition, permit, quality and schedule changes route to responsible parties.

title: Implement lawful commercial fee controls
acceptance_criterion: Fee types, jurisdictions, tax, invoicing and licensing exposure are approved before activation.

title: Implement marketplace public/private projections
acceptance_criterion: Public discovery cannot expose provenance, private evidence, counterparties, negotiation or restricted data.

title: Certify transaction-layer release
acceptance_criterion: Unverified parties and failed gates cannot transact; fees, documents, shipment evidence and leakage controls pass.

title: Establish multilingual source operations
acceptance_criterion: Language-specific parsers, translation review, terminology and quality benchmarks operate by jurisdiction.

title: Expand municipal, tribal and autonomous coverage
acceptance_criterion: Lower-level authorities and conflicts with higher-level law are modeled and coverage status is visible.

title: Deploy regional data-residency cells
acceptance_criterion: Residency cells enforce tenant placement, restricted replication, encryption and tested recovery.

title: Implement private and sovereign deployment pattern
acceptance_criterion: Customer-isolated deployments preserve contracts, evidence lineage, update delivery and support boundaries.

title: Build government and regulator workspace
acceptance_criterion: Regulator workflows support controlled data exchange, inspections, registers and public transparency without customer leakage.

title: Implement global coverage assurance programme
acceptance_criterion: Coverage SLAs, source gaps, legal changes, analyst capacity and public claims are continuously reconciled.

title: Implement model localization and evaluation
acceptance_criterion: Every supported language/jurisdiction has benchmark, review authority, failure thresholds and rollback.

title: Implement advanced policy and market scenarios
acceptance_criterion: Scenarios combine regulatory probability, obligations, corridors, entities and market effects with explicit uncertainty.

title: Implement customer data warehouse delivery
acceptance_criterion: Versioned bulk tables, change data, rights, lineage and deletion/termination controls operate at enterprise scale.

title: Implement external agent and MCP control plane
acceptance_criterion: Agents receive scoped tools, citations, approvals, rate limits and auditable actions; no hidden autonomous decisions.

title: Complete institutional assurance programme
acceptance_criterion: SOC 2/ISO readiness, BCP, privacy, accessibility, penetration testing and vendor risk are independently evidenced.

title: Operate continuous global release gate
acceptance_criterion: Quarterly coverage, quality, security, model, rights, cost and commercial evidence produces GO/HOLD by module and region.
